description: The ECB's reference rates as fixings, oldest first, each currency in units per 1 EUR as the ECB published it. With date (default today): every currency's rate in force that day, all from one fixing, whose date the answer gives. With from (and to, default today): every fixing the ECB published in the window, as many as fit in 2000 rates a call (a year of seven currencies, or all of them for about three months). Name currencies to narrow either; leave them out for all. Use it for a chart, an average or a check across several days.

currencies.description: ISO 4217 codes, e.g. ["USD", "GBP"], without EUR; default every currency the ECB published.

items.description: ISO 4217 code: USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, ...; EUR where the tool allows it; case ignored.

date.description: One day, YYYY-MM-DD in Frankfurt: the rates in force on it. Not with from.

from.description: A window's first day, YYYY-MM-DD: every fixing from it to `to`.

to.description: A window's last day, included; default today. Only with from.

name: rates

absent.description: Currencies asked for that the ECB published no rate of in the window

count.description: How many rates the fixings hold

date.description: The day asked for: fixings holds the one in force on it

fixing_date.description: With date: the date of the fixing that was in force

fixings.description: Oldest first; a currency the ECB did not publish on a fixing is missing from that fixing's rates

additionalProperties.description: The ECB's exact value, units of the currency per 1 EUR

rates.description: Units of each currency per 1 EUR on that fixing

title: ECB rates: every currency on a day, or a window
